entities.name: Query protein 157 aa
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q17VS8, annotated as lipoprotein signal peptidase.
Sequence length is 157 aa; predicted molecular weight is 17.94 kDa; GRAVY is 0.8255, consistent with a strongly hydrophobic membrane protein.
Contains Peptidase_A8 domain PF01252.24 at positions 15–147 with i-Evalue 3.8e-24.

entities.name: Q17VS8
observations: Reviewed Helicobacter acinonychis lipoprotein signal peptidase; exact sequence match to the query.
Annotated as specifically catalyzing removal of signal peptides from prolipoproteins.
Localized to the cell inner membrane and classified as a multi-pass membrane protein.

entities.name: Bacterial lipoprotein biosynthesis
observations: The protein participates in protein modification and lipoprotein biosynthesis through signal-peptide cleavage.

entities.name: Proteolysis
observations: Associated GO biological process is proteolysis (GO:0006508), specifically cleavage of prolipoprotein signal peptides.
